Class NativeLedMatrix

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.internal.NativeLedMatrix
All Implemented Interfaces:
Display
public final class NativeLedMatrix extends Object implements Display
The board's built-in LED matrix as a Display: 12x8 on the UNO R4 WiFi, 13x8 on the UNO Q, one color. A color other than Display.BLACK lights a pixel. Drawing changes a four-word buffer and flush() sends it to the matrix, so a program draws a whole frame before it flushes. Text is one line of 6x8 cells at size 1, the only size that fits the 8 rows: setTextSize(int) is accepted and ignored, and text past the right edge is clipped, not wrapped.

MCU.getDisplay() hands this out on the UNO R4 WiFi and the UNO Q. The four matrix operations are intrinsics the compiler lowers to the Arduino_LED_Matrix library; everything else is plain Java over the buffer, so a unit test can draw into it without the board.
